newsitem.title: USA: Kerr-McGee titanium dioxide price to rise.
newsitem.headline: Kerr-McGee titanium dioxide price to rise.

text.p: Kerr-McGee Corp's Kerr-McGee Chemical Corp said Tuesday it will increase the price of titanium dioxide pigment by $0.05 per pound for bulk, bag or slurry shipments to accounts in North America.
The increase will take effect January 1, 1997.
Kerr-McGee projects that worldwide demand for titanium dioxide pigment will increase about 3.3 percent in 1997 after below-average demand growth in 1995 and 1996.
International markets also are improving, although at a slower rate than the North American market, said Pete Woodward, senior vice president of sales for Kerr-McGee Chemical.
